# Storyboard: Chapter 11, The Warrior Ceremony

*Generated by `tools/storyboard.mjs` from `app/story/ch11.js`. Do not edit by hand: change the story file and run `node tools/storyboard.mjs` again.*

## How to read this

Every screen of the game is one comic panel, called a frame. Frames are listed in reading order. Each one has:

- **Shot**: the storyboard, written for an illustrator (camera, who is where, what the moment feels like, where the lettering goes).
- **Scene**: what the game draws today, in plain words: the set, the camera, who is in shot and how, and any effects.
- **Captions**: the narration boxes, read first. **Balloons**: who speaks, in order. **Sound effect**: the big lettering. A line marked *(only if …)* shows only to a reader whose choices match.
- **Then**: what the reader does next (tap Next, choose, type, pick a look, count by twos, or do a Counts lesson).

Where the reader makes a choice, each option’s frames are grouped under a **Branch** heading, and the branches meet again at the frame named after them. `{name}` is the first part of her Clan name (Moon makes Moonpaw), `{petname}` is what her Tall One calls her, and `{they}`/`{them}`/`{their}` become she/her/her or he/him/his. `{Murmur}`/`{murmur}` is the tortoiseshell’s name word: Murmur (Murmurpaw, Murmurchime, murmuring), or Mutter for a reader whose own Clan name is Murmur. `{ending}` is her warrior ending, `paw` until the Ceremony (Fernpaw, then Fernheart).

### f001 · panel 1

**Shot.** WIDE, THE CAMP BY MOONLIGHT. The moon has come up over the wild garden, one evening past full and lit on its left, and the dens, the ferns, the mossy paths and the old stone fountain all shine silver-blue; nobody is on the fountain yet. Two Clan cats pad in toward it from the edges. Three captions in a column, top left.

**Scene.** Camp: CrystalClan’s camp, the wild garden behind the hedge, at night (bramble dens, ferns, mossy stone paths, a dry stone fountain, glass towers all around). Camera: wide establishing shot (`reveal`). Cast: a Clan cat (walking, happy, in the crowd, left, facing right, coat 2); a Clan cat (walking, happy, in the ferns, facing left, coat 4). Also: the moon, 15 evenings old. Effects: night.

**Captions**

> The moon comes up over camp.
>
> The dens, the ferns, the old stone fountain: everything is silver.
>
> This morning, you passed your Warrior Counts. Tonight, the Clan gathers. For your name.

## The Case File’s cards

A piece of bark for each thing she finds out: one picture scratched in, one line, and a mark in a corner (an eye for what she saw herself, an ear for what she was only told). Each goes into her Case File at the panel that gives it, in this order:

| Card | Mark | Its line | Given at | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## The book page

Title: *{name}paw’s First Moon*. This chapter’s page, under “Chapter 11: The Warrior Ceremony”. Lines shown when their condition matches the reader’s choices:

- (always) On the evening {name}paw passed {their} Warrior Counts, all of CrystalClan gathered in camp under the moon.
- (always) Tallyheart sat right beside {them}, and {Murmur}chime sat in the front row, as she promised.
- (always) Glintstar told the Clan what {name}paw did this moon, and every cat promised to stand by {them}.
- (if ch11Named is "offer") Glintstar saw three names in {name}paw, and {they} chose {name}{ending}.
- (if ch11Named is "self") Glintstar saw three names in {name}paw, but {they} named {them}self {name}{ending}.
- (always) The whole Clan called the new name, Riffle cheered it from the hedge, and under the moon the mist stone flashed: hello from Sprinkle.
- (always) {name}{ending} kept watch over the sleeping camp till the first light, then counted the pile: forty, not one piece gone.
- (always) Then {they} slept in a warrior’s nest for the very first time, right beside {Murmur}chime’s.
- (no dream typed) {name}{ending}’s first dream in a warrior’s nest stayed a secret.
